---
# Clinic parameter options are: 
# All, AF Williams, Boulder, Lone Tree, Westminster, WISH
# Options do not need to be in quotes
params:
  clinic: All
    
title: "DFM Health Equities Survey 2024"
subtitle: "`r params$clinic`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d %Y')`"

# Quarto docx settings ---------------------------------------------------------
# fig height, width, and dpi set to prevent overplotting and image quality
format:
  docx:
    toc: true
    output-file: test.docx
  
editor: source
  
execute: 
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r load libraries}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
pacman::p_load(here,
               tidyverse,
               gtsummary,
               bstfun,
               Hmisc,
               flextable)

# Suppress summarise warnings
# options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) 
```

```{r source process data}
# Source in RMD has to be relative to the script
# source(here::here("scripts", "process_data.R"))

# 2024
# Should load the data either as a master file data_2024_lab for factored
# responses or data_2024_raw for numerical responses
source(here::here("scripts", "prep_data.R"))
data <- data_2024_lab
```

```{r source project specific functions}
source(here::here("functions", "practice_equity_functions.R"))
```

```{r source all purpose functions}
# source("C:/Users/rodrica2/OneDrive/Sync Files/R_functions/flatten_list_function.R")
# source("C:/Users/rodrica2/OneDrive/Sync Files/R_functions/fit_flextable_function.R")
```

```{r subset_data}
practice <- params$clinic
# Check to see if a specific clinic was entered into the function. If the 
  # string "All" is the function input, then the data will not be filtered by
  # practice.
if (practice == "All"){
  temp <- data
} else {
  temp <- data %>%
  filter(demographic_1_practice == practice)
}
```

```{r apply report function}
# report_practice() is a function that takes in as input the practice which
# is set in the yaml header of the quarto document.
report_practice(practice)
```

```{r generate the free response tables}
# Use the free vars and free names as inputs to the function via map2, assign 
# to a list to avoid outputting code to the word document
# fr_tabs <- map2(free_vars, free_names, ~generate_fr_tab(.x, .y))
```

```{r resident, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (practice == "AF Williams"){
  tab.residency <- data %>% 
    filter(Practice == "AF Williams", 
           Role == "Clinician/Provider") %>%
    select(Residency) %>%
    tbl_summary(missing = "no",
                label = list(Residency = "Yes")) %>%
    modify_header(label = "Residency status amongst Clinician/Providers") %>%
    as_gt()
  tab.residency
}
```
